text.zh: 同一公会的公会箱共用内容。想从另一处取回材料，先把材料放进公会箱，再到另一个公会箱打开。
text.en: Move supplies between guild chests by depositing them at one and withdrawing them at another.

text.zh: 忘了材料放在哪个箱子时，在该据点用道具取出机搜索并取出。搜索范围是当前据点的箱子。
text.en: At the base, use the Item Retrieval Machine to find and withdraw supplies from its chests.

text.zh: 在帕鲁远征所组织队伍去远征，完成远征可领取物资。挑选目标时先对照各远征的奖励清单。
text.en: Dispatch Pals at an Expedition Station for supplies. Choose the destination by its reward list.

text.zh: 在帕鲁劳动研究所推进研究可获得持续的据点生产加成。有些提高工作速度的设施也需要先完成研究。
text.en: Research at the Pal Labor Research Laboratory provides lasting productivity upgrades and unlocks some work-speed facilities.

text.zh: 召出的帕鲁三项主动技能都在冷却时，仍可使用其属性的基础攻击。
text.en: A summoned Pal can use a basic elemental attack while all three equipped moves are cooling down.

text.zh: 对应工种的技术书可永久提高一只帕鲁的该项工作适性。先选要培养的个体，再核对书对应的工种。
text.en: Choose the worker and match the technique book to its job. The suitability increase is permanent.

text.zh: 可在跳蚤市场向其他玩家出售帕鲁或物品。想找固定商品的 NPC 商店时，需要查商人货单。
text.en: A Flea Market lets players offer Pals or items for sale to other players.

text.zh: 异次元帕鲁仓库可让公会成员共同使用，也可在权限里设为私人储存。开放前先核对访问设置。
text.en: Dimensional Pal Storage can be shared with guild members or set to private use.

text.zh: 把可合成的低稀有度设计图拿到制图台，可以制成更高稀有度的图纸。制作装备仍要查成品配方。
text.en: Use a Drafting Table to combine eligible lower-rarity schematics into a higher-rarity schematic.

text.zh: 在跳蚤市场安排冰属性帕鲁，可减慢已存放或正在出售物品的腐坏速度。
text.en: Assign an Ice Pal to the Flea Market to slow spoilage for stock in storage or on sale.

text.zh: 打开帕鲁指令轮盘进入拍照模式，可隐藏界面并调整相机位置。
text.en: Open Photo Mode from the Pal command wheel to hide the interface and reposition the camera.

text.zh: 在古董梳妆台设置护甲外观即可换造型，战斗属性由实际穿戴装备决定。
text.en: Set a cosmetic appearance at an Antique Dresser while keeping the stats of the equipped armour.

text.zh: 0.5.0 开始支持跨平台一起游玩。跨平台联机和跨世界带走帕鲁是两个功能；后者使用跨界帕鲁终端。
text.en: Cross-platform multiplayer arrived in 0.5.0. For transferring a Pal between worlds, use a Global Palbox.

text.zh: 先准备钓竿和鱼饵，再去水中有鱼影的钓点抛竿。
text.en: Prepare a rod and bait, then cast where fish silhouettes mark a fishing spot.

text.zh: 骑能在水上行动的帕鲁到海面打捞点操作钓竿，可回收包括矿石在内的物资。
text.en: Ride a water mount to a marine salvage spot and use the fishing rod to recover supplies, including ore.

text.zh: 和帕鲁相处可提升信赖并增加属性。基础属性较低的帕鲁可获得较大的信赖修正。
text.en: Time spent with a Pal builds trust and improves stats. Lower starting stats receive a larger trust adjustment.

text.zh: 想让佐伊成为同伴，推进她的专属任务，完成任务取得她的信任。
text.en: Complete Zoe's own missions to earn her trust and recruit her.

text.zh: 单人竞技场挑战可通过胜利提高排名、获取战斗票券。多人竞技场另有观战和对战规则设置。
text.en: Solo Arena victories raise rank and award battle tickets. Multiplayer also supports spectating and match restrictions.

text.zh: 要同时孵多颗蛋，可使用大型孵蛋器，把各颗待孵的蛋放进去。
text.en: A Large Incubator hatches several eggs at the same time.

text.zh: 进攻敌对阵营的基地，有机会带回该阵营建筑使用的设计图。
text.en: Enemy faction bases are a source of blueprints for that faction's buildings.

entries.section: New Areas and World Improvements / Watchtowers

text.zh: 抵达瞭望塔并与其互动，可显示周围地图；之后还能把它用作传送点。
text.en: Activate a watchtower to reveal nearby terrain and use it as a travel point.

text.zh: 身处据点范围时，可直接打开大地图选择可用目的地，无须先走回帕鲁终端。
text.en: Inside base range, select an available destination on the map without walking back to the Palbox.

text.zh: 1.0 的手工作业帕鲁修理建筑不消耗修理包。检查据点是否有可工作的手工作业帕鲁。
text.en: Handiwork Pals can repair structures without repair kits in 1.0.

text.zh: 据点等级影响可能到访的专业商人种类。弹药、药品和食材商人各有分工。
text.en: Base level influences which visiting specialists can appear, including ammunition, medicine and food traders.

text.zh: 深入世界树寻找觉醒使用的辉光宝石，用于强化选中的帕鲁。
text.en: Find Radiant Gems in the World Tree for a Pal's awakening.

text.zh: 公会可按角色授予权限，某些建筑还支持按角色限制访问。让管理员同时检查成员角色和建筑访问设置。
text.en: Guild roles carry permissions. For a restricted structure, check both the member's role and that structure's access settings.

text.zh: 同一公会同一时间可进行一场团体战首领战，先结束进行中的战斗再开下一场。
text.en: Each guild can run one raid-boss battle at a time.

text.zh: 1.0.3 把水上建造套装的解锁条件改为角色 23 级、1 点古代科技点。
text.en: The Aquatic Construction Kit unlock costs one Ancient Technology Point at level 23 in 1.0.3.

text.zh: 1.0.3 的来源包括世界树远征、世界树区域钓鱼和大型钓鱼池，可按已有设施选择途径。
text.en: World Tree expeditions, fishing in the World Tree and Large Fishing Ponds can yield World Tree Holy Water.

text.zh: 世界树圣水在 1.0.3 的单个基础重量是 0.1，计算搬运负重时可用数量乘 0.1。
text.en: Each unit of World Tree Holy Water has a base weight of 0.1 in 1.0.3.

text.zh: 在生产设施取消工作时，退回的材料进入背包。若取消的是建筑施工或拆建筑，则还要考虑超重物品的自动拾取设置。
text.en: Canceling a production order returns materials to inventory. Building cancellation and dismantling use separate overweight-pickup rules.

text.zh: 1.0.4 中，樱岛的帕鲁评论家想看汪宗师，Sunreach 的评论家想看伊西斯。按地点准备对应帕鲁。
text.en: In 1.0.4, the Sakurajima Pal Critic asks to see Dogen and the Sunreach critic asks for Faleris Aqua.

en: from the far side of the moon

text.zh: 在黑曜火山的渔村找 NPC 接 Beyond Dimensions。完成后再推进后续任务 From the Far Side of the Moon。
text.en: Start Beyond Dimensions with the NPC at Fisherman's Point on Mount Obsidian to unlock the follow-up moon mission.

text.zh: 1.0.4 起，接触玩家建造的篝火不会点燃玩家、召出的帕鲁或据点帕鲁。此条只针对玩家建造的篝火。
text.en: Contact with a player-built campfire no longer sets players, summoned Pals or base Pals alight in 1.0.4.

text.zh: 召出的帕鲁和据点帕鲁选择主动招式时，会优先考虑预期伤害较高的招式。
text.en: Summoned and base Pals prioritize skills with higher expected damage in 1.0.4.

text.zh: 可用异性的吹雪狐和熔岩兽配出寒霜兽。把这两只设为亲本，再给配种牧场备蛋糕。
text.en: An opposite-sex Foxcicle and Reptyro pair produces Reptyro Cryst.

text.zh: 棉悠悠和燎火鹿是产出企丸丸的一组亲本。给牧场安排一公一母。
text.en: An opposite-sex Lamball and Rooby pair produces Pengullet.

text.zh: 棉悠悠和猫蝠怪是获得融焰娘的一组亲本，分别选择不同性别。
text.en: An opposite-sex Lamball and Tombat pair produces Flambelle.

text.zh: 阿努比斯在 55 级自然学会沙尘暴。培养现有个体等升级即可解锁这招。
text.en: Anubis learns Sand Twister by reaching level 55.

text.zh: 棉悠悠的等级招式表在 22 级列有自爆。想让现有个体学这招，可以直接培养到该等级。
text.en: Lamball's level-up list includes the self-destructing move Implode at level 22.
